t: This Milwaukee Glass and Tile Bit is an essential tool for precise drilling in non-toughened glass, soft to medium-hard tiles, and ceramics. Ideal for plumbers, tilers, and general builders undertaking bathroom and kitchen installations, its sharpened carbide tips ensure faster drilling performance. A reinforced carbide head significantly increases durability and extends service life, providing reliable use on site. The multi-flat anti-slip shank design prevents slipping in combi drill chucks, offering improved control and safety during both wet and dry applications. A red painted tip allows for quick identification among other drill bits.
b: Suitable for Tiles, Porcelain, Ceramics & Non-Toughened Glass
